description: A `mark` job's worker says the job is complete, with what a `mark` job reports.

_userId.description: Authenticated user's DID, injected by the /bus/emit gateway. Clients do not set this.

attempt.description: Which attempt produced this event, 1-based (a first run is 1). ALWAYS present: the queue re-runs a failed job silently, so an operator reading progress or a terminal record has no other way to tell a re-run from a first run — and provider spend, already counted in semiont_inference_tokens_total, cannot be attributed to a repeated document without it. Stated rather than inferred from absence, because 'attempt 1' is a fact the emitter always knows.
